HubSpot deal: HS-12345
Drive head: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSIG-MedTechAI

Best,
Alice

Team — looping you in. MedTech wants a completed SIG + artifacts by 2027-04-14. Can we break this into owners and micro-deadlines:

- Controls matrix (owner: Karthik) — draft by 2027-04-06
- Network diagram (owner: Priyom) — draft by 2027-04-05
- Encryption & key mgmt excerpts (owner: Monica) — draft by 2027-04-07

I'll coordinate a brief stand-up on Wednesday morning (15 mins) to surface blockers. If anyone sees schedule conflicts, flag them now.

Thanks — Lauren
